definitions.gloss: to distinguish; to tell apart; to differentiate
definitions.explanation: To recognize the difference between similar things or people by looking at them.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}を{見分|みわ}けるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to tell twins apart.

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}と{偽物|にせもの}を{見分|みわ}ける{方法|ほうほう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please teach me how to distinguish the real from the fake.

examples.japanese: {新鮮|しんせん}な{魚|さかな}と{古|ふる}い{魚|さかな}を{見分|みわ}けられますか。
examples.english: Can you tell fresh fish from old fish?

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Takes を. Compound verb: {見|み}る + {分|わ}ける.

NUANCE: Emphasizes visual discrimination - the ability to see and recognize differences. Compare with {聞|き}き{分|わ}ける (to distinguish by hearing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・AとBを{見分|みわ}ける: to tell A and B apart
・{見分|みわ}けがつかない: to be indistinguishable
・{見分|みわ}けられる: to be able to distinguish

SIMILAR:
・{区別|くべつ}する: to distinguish, to differentiate (more general)
・{判別|はんべつ}する: to discriminate, to identify (more formal)
